heading: OfficialThing
text: An item that is officially issued by an Agent.

heading: Direction
text: The orientation of a line or movement.

heading: VersionedThing
text: An identifiable version of a managed object.

heading: ComparisonOperatorCode
text: A code representing a comparison operator.

heading: Code
text: A code value whose meaning is defined by membership in (or reference to) a code list.

heading: CodeList
text: A curated set of codes (a code list), maintained and versioned by some entity.

heading: AngleUnit
text: A specified system of units for angles.

heading: Angle
text: An angle defined by two lines.

heading: Bearing
text: The orientation of a line or movement, measured from north (0°) clockwise.

heading: ActivationStatusCode
text: A code indicating the activation status of an object

heading: DirectionCode
text: A code representing orientation of a line or movement.

heading: ITSObjectProperty
text: An object property to organize all object properties defined in all recognized ITS Ontologies.

heading: enteredBy
text: The Agent that entered the OfficialThing.

heading: fromCodeList
text: Associates a code with the code list that defines it.

heading: hasActivationStatus
text: The activation status of the object.

heading: hasJurisdiction
text: The jurisdiction associated with the object.

heading: hasRegisteredCode
text: Associates a code list with a registered member code.

heading: issuingAuthority
text: The Agent that issued the OfficialThing.

heading: managedBy
text: Associates a code list with a registered member code.

heading: ITSDataProperty
text: A datatype property to organize all datatype properties defined in all recognized ITS Ontologies.

heading: codeValue
text: The lexical value of a code.

heading: enteredOn
text: The date the OfficialThing was entered.

heading: hasImage
text: The binary content of an image embedded as base64-encoded bytes.

heading: hasMaintainer
text: The maintainer of the code list (free-text identifier; can be replaced with a richer organization model later).

heading: hasName
text: A human-readable name for the code list.

heading: hasUrl
text: The URL associated with the object.

heading: hasVersion
text: The version of the object.

heading: issuedOn
text: The date the OfficialThing was issued.

heading: lastModified
text: Date the code list was last modified.
